auth_details: No API key required for read-only public requests. Optional MediaWiki account/OAuth for authenticated or write actions; identify clients with a descriptive User-Agent.
free_tier_limits: Free for public read access; no paid API plans
rate_limits: Wikimedia etiquette: use descriptive User-Agent; maxlag; limit concurrency; no hard public RPS published — see API:Etiquette / bot policy
description: Public MediaWiki API for Wiktionary providing dictionary definitions, translations, etymology, and linguistic data across many languages. Query page content, parse wikitext, search terms, and access structured extracts without a paid account.
